subject: Legal handshake: security exhibit audit rhythm & ops sprint
content:
From: laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
To: anita.shah@healthbridge.com
Cc: marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com, priyom.das@redwoodinference.com, grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2027-05-05T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Legal handshake: security exhibit audit rhythm & ops sprint

Hi Anita —

Thanks for getting the security exhibit discussion scheduled. I wanted to put a short kickoff note here so both teams are aligned before we hand to Legal and Security on our sides. Key goals for this thread:

- Confirm audit rights language we can accept (SOC 2 evidence, pen-test notice window, and limited staging access).
- Agree an evidence cadence matrix and owner list so HealthBridge has a predictable delivery rhythm.
- Surface any order-form constraints that would block signing next-week (e.g., restricted inspection windows, 3rd-party pen-test carveouts).

Attached are two working files: our redline (HealthBridge_Security_Exhibit_redline_v1.docx) and a draft evidence matrix (RBW_evidence_matrix_draft.xlsx) that maps SOC 2 assertions to the artifacts HealthBridge typically asks for.

Initial asks:
1) Can you confirm preferred pen-test notice window (30 vs 45 days) and whether HealthBridge requires ephemeral staging that we need to provision?
2) Who on your legal team should we expect to see redlines from (name + email) so we can route responses?
3) Any procurement timing constraints on your side — do you need the MSA + order form signed together or is a two-step (MSA then order form) OK?

Marcus (cc) will own the technical evidence mapping; Priyom will coordinate the legal queue and redline responses. Grace will run the ops sprint once dates are locked.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this into a short playbook so we can avoid back-and-forth during negotiation.

—Laura Bennett
Head of Policy & Strategic Contracts
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: HealthBridge_Security_Exhibit_redline_v1.docx (docx)]
[Attachment: RBW_evidence_matrix_draft.xlsx (xlsx)]

-----
From: Anita Shah <anita@healthbridge.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
Cc: james.liu@healthbridge.com, procurement@healthbridge.com
Date: 2027-05-05T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Legal handshake: security exhibit audit rhythm & ops sprint

Hi Laura — great to meet you in this thread.

Thanks for the materials; I skimmed the matrix and it looks like you’ve captured the main asks. Answers inline:

1) Pen-test notice: our standard is 45 days for production-facing tests and 30 days for staging-only. If you can distinguish (and commit in the exhibit) to staging-only for shorter notice we can accept 30 days.
2) Legal reviewers: James Liu (james.liu@healthbridge.com) will take the first pass on MSA/exhibit language; our GC (Anita Shah) will step in for any policy-level exceptions.
3) Procurement timing: we prefer to sign the MSA and order form together, but we can move to signature if MSA language is finalized and a binding order form is attached. Procurement needs a 72-hour window for internal approvals after redline finalization.

Two quick asks from our side:
- Can Redwood commit to a test witness requirement for pen-tests on shared infra? If so, please note that in the exhibit.
- We require a 3-year retention note for audit logs in the exhibit; if that conflicts with your platform policy, flag it now.

I’ll put James on the legal thread once he’s done with the initial pass.

Thanks,
Anita
Director, InfoSec & Compliance
HealthBridge Systems

-----
From: marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com
To: anita.shah@healthbridge.com, laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
Cc: priyom.das@redwoodinference.com, grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2027-05-05T14:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Legal handshake: security exhibit audit rhythm & ops sprint

Anita / Laura —

Thanks. Quick technical clarifications from our infra team:

- Staging-only pen-tests: we can support a staging-only 30-day notice with a time-boxed environment (ephemeral staging) and logs preserved for the requested window.
- Test witness: Redwood can provide an engineer-as-witness for on-prem or dedicated-reserved runs; for hosted multitenant endpoints we can provide aggregated evidence and monitoring telemetry but not live console access.
- Audit logs: we retain operational logs for 18 months by default; we can provide a 3-year retention option as part of a Dedicated/Private deployment addendum (this will change pricing).

Action items I propose:
- Marcus: produce a short appendix that states what evidence we can provide for hosted vs dedicated vs private.
- Laura/Priyom: align on legal redline timeline so we hit HealthBridge procurement windows.

I’ll attach a short tech appendix into the drive folder after this note.

—Marcus Lin
Sr. Manager, Infrastructure
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: RBW_tech_appendix_staging_notes.md (md)]

-----
From: priyom.das@redwoodinference.com
To: james.liu@healthbridge.com, anita.shah@healthbridge.com
Cc: laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com, marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com, grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2027-05-06T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Legal handshake: security exhibit audit rhythm & ops sprint

James / Anita —

Looping in as discussed. Laura and Marcus have prepared redlines and a tech appendix. From legal side we propose the following negotiation cadence to align with procurement:

- Day 0 (today): We share document bundle (done).
- Day 1–2: HealthBridge legal provides initial comments.
- Day 3–4: Redwood returns consolidated responses to legal redlines.
- Day 5–7: Finalize language and prepare signatures (aim for 72-hour procurement window).

If HealthBridge needs more time in any step, please flag the steps and we will expand the ops sprint accordingly. Note that any request to move 3-year retention to hosted must be routed to pricing (I’ll open a pricing ticket if that’s requested).

Please confirm next steps and whether we should schedule a 30-minute legal sync later this week to walk through high-impact clauses (audit rights, pen-test carveouts, log retention).

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Senior Counsel, Commercial Contracts
Redwood Inference

-----
From: James Liu <james.liu@healthbridge.com>
To: priyom.das@redwoodinference.com, laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
Cc: anita.shah@healthbridge.com, marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com, procurement@healthbridge.com
Date: 2027-05-06T13:09:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Legal handshake: security exhibit audit rhythm & ops sprint

Priyom / Laura —

Thanks for the clear cadence. I reviewed the redline and have three higher-priority requests:

1) Scoped inspection: we need the MSA exhibit to explicitly limit production inspection to cases triggered by a security incident or contractual breach — otherwise our compliance team will escalate.
2) Pen-test evidence: we require signed attestation from the vendor performing the pen-test plus a short executive summary (no raw exploit code).
3) Timing on evidence deliverables: procurement needs a simple table that maps artifact -> owner -> SLA. Can Redwood populate that from your RBW_evidence_matrix_draft.xlsx and return a 48-hour update?

Assuming we get the updated table and a short note on retention pricing, procurement will queue for internal approval. I’ll aim to have comments back by end of day tomorrow.

—James Liu
Contracts Counsel
HealthBridge Systems

-----
From: laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
To: james.liu@healthbridge.com, anita.shah@healthbridge.com
Cc: marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com, priyom.das@redwoodinference.com, grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2027-05-07T17:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Legal handshake: security exhibit audit rhythm & ops sprint

James / Anita —

Great — we’ll do the following immediately:

1) Marcus will convert the evidence matrix into the artifact -> owner -> SLA table and return it by 2027-05-08T11:00 PT (48 hours).
2) I’ll update the exhibit redline to include scoped inspection language that limits production inspection to incident/breach triggers and circulate to you this evening.
3) Priyom will open a pricing ticket for the 3-year log retention option and include a short note on cost delta.
4) Grace will propose a 30-minute legal sync for 2027-05-09 or 2027-05-10 — Doodle link below.

Appreciate the clarity. If we can close the redline and get the artifact table into procurement’s hands on Monday, we should be able to meet your procurement window.

Best,
Laura
Head of Policy & Strategic Contracts
Redwood Inference
